## Summary

What problem does this change solve, and how?

## Verification

List the commands and scenarios you ran. For native changes, describe the Windows runtime validation and any gaps. Do not include unredacted desktop output.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear scope and follows the domain/platform separation.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Checks pass on the supported Rust versions and applicable platforms.
- [ ] New code or assets can be contributed under GPL-3.0-only; required third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation, comments, and user-facing text are in English.
